verdict.rationale: Mangopay offers machine-readable surfaces an agent can work from: an llms.txt with explicit AI-agent instructions, Markdown versions of every page, a live openapi.json, a documented official MCP server, and SDKs in six languages. The money-side domain is documented too: wallets that hold funds, payout guides, and disputes the platform can contest by providing proof. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of balance-read and payout-status endpoints for investigating a missing payout, a documented API for submitting dispute evidence documents, clarity on whether the MCP server exposes operational API actions or only docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent use.
